tasks.title: Implement Early Persistence for mondayItemId
tasks.description: Modify the saveFormResponse server action to immediately persist mondayItemId after successful Monday create_item operation.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for the createMondayItem function with mocked Monday API responses including success, rate limit (429), and other errors.
2. Integration test to verify mondayItemId is persisted to the database immediately after Monday item creation.
3. Test retry logic by simulating rate limit responses and verifying backoff behavior.
4. Verify database schema changes with test migrations.
5. End-to-end test to confirm the entire flow works correctly with actual API calls in a test environment.

tasks.title: Create Background Processing for Subitems
tasks.description: Implement a background processing mechanism for handling subitem creation to prevent serverless timeouts during checkout.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test for the processSubitems function with mocked Supabase and Monday API responses.
2. Test concurrency control by verifying that only the specified number of subitems are processed simultaneously.
3. Verify incremental updates by checking that the database is updated after each successful subitem creation.
4. Test error handling by simulating failures in subitem creation and verifying proper status updates.
5. End-to-end test with the API route to ensure the background processing works correctly.
6. Load test to verify performance under high volume of subitems.

tasks.title: Implement Retry Logic with Exponential Backoff
tasks.description: Add comprehensive retry logic with exponential backoff for all Monday API calls to handle rate limiting and transient failures.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for the resilientMondayApiCall function with various error scenarios:
   - Rate limit (429) responses
   - Network errors
   - Server errors (5xx)
   - Non-retryable errors
2. Verify exponential backoff timing with mocked timers
3. Integration tests for each Monday API function (createItem, createSubitem, updateItemStatus)
4. Test with simulated slow network conditions
5. Verify maximum retry behavior works as expected
6. End-to-end test with actual Monday API in test environment

tasks.title: Optimize Monday API Calls with Consolidated Queries
tasks.description: Reduce the number of Monday API calls by consolidating multiple queries into single requests and implementing efficient data fetching patterns.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for the consolidated query function to verify it correctly extracts multiple column values.
2. Performance tests comparing the old approach (multiple queries) vs. the new consolidated approach.
3. Test batch processing with various batch sizes to determine optimal performance.
4. Test the rate limiter with simulated API calls to verify concurrency control.
5. Verify that the rate limiter properly spaces out requests according to the configured interval.
6. Integration tests with the actual Monday API to confirm reduced API calls.
7. Load testing to verify performance improvements under high volume.

tasks.title: Enhance Database Schema for Processing Status
tasks.description: Update the database schema to track processing status and metadata for better visibility and recovery options.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Create test migrations to verify schema changes apply correctly.
2. Unit tests for the helper functions (updateProcessingStatus, recordItemResult, logProcessingEvent).
3. Integration tests to verify the functions correctly update the database.
4. Test edge cases like updating non-existent records or handling null/undefined values.
5. Verify that the processing_logs table correctly captures events.
6. Test concurrent updates to ensure data integrity.
7. Performance tests to ensure the additional logging doesn't significantly impact system performance.

tasks.title: Optimize Checkin Flow with Consolidated Queries
tasks.description: Enhance the checkin process to use consolidated Monday API queries and add retry logic for improved reliability.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for the updateMondaySubitems function with mocked API responses.
2. Test the convertToMondayColumnValues function with various input data.
3. Integration tests for the updateFormResponse function to verify it correctly updates both Monday and the local database.
4. Test error handling and retry logic by simulating API failures.
5. Test with various batch sizes of subitems to verify performance.
6. End-to-end tests for the entire checkin flow from UI to database.
7. Verify proper status updates in the UI during the checkin process.

tasks.title: Implement Enhanced Client-Side Feedback
tasks.description: Update the client-side UI to provide better feedback during checkout and checkin processes, including status indicators and polling for background processes.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for the StatusIndicator component to verify it renders correctly for different states.
2. Test the polling mechanism with mocked API responses to verify it correctly updates UI state.
3. Test the checkout form's state transitions through the entire flow.
4. Verify the status API endpoint returns correct data.
5. Test error handling in the UI components.
6. End-to-end tests for the complete checkout flow with status updates.
7. Usability testing to ensure the feedback is clear and helpful to users.
8. Test with slow network conditions to verify the UI remains responsive.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Logging and Observability
tasks.description: Add structured logging, error tracking, and performance monitoring to provide better visibility into the checkout and checkin processes.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for the logger utility functions.
2. Verify log output format and content with various input scenarios.
3. Test the metrics collector with simulated function executions.
4. Integration tests to verify logs are properly generated during order processing.
5. Test the admin API endpoint for retrieving logs.
6. Verify that sensitive information is not logged.
7. Performance tests to ensure logging doesn't significantly impact system performance.
8. Test log rotation and retention if applicable.

tasks.title: Create Admin Dashboard for Order Processing Management
tasks.description: Develop an admin interface to monitor order processing status, view logs, and manually retry failed operations.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for the admin dashboard components.
2. Test the API endpoints with various input scenarios.
3. Verify authentication and authorization for admin routes.
4. Test the retry functionality for both orders and individual subitems.
5. Verify that the dashboard correctly displays order status and processing logs.
6. Test the polling mechanism for real-time updates.
7. Verify that the UI correctly handles loading states and errors.
8. End-to-end tests for the complete admin workflow.

tasks.title: Implement End-to-End Testing and Deployment Pipeline
tasks.description: Create comprehensive end-to-end tests for the checkout and checkin flows, and set up a CI/CD pipeline for reliable deployments.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Set up Cypress for end-to-end testing of the checkout and checkin flows.
2. Create test cases for happy paths and error scenarios, including rate limiting and retries.
3. Implement mocks for Monday API to simulate various responses.
4. Set up GitHub Actions workflow for continuous integration and deployment.
5. Create separate environments for testing, staging, and production.
6. Implement load testing to verify performance under high traffic.
7. Test database migrations to ensure schema changes apply correctly.
8. Verify that the deployment pipeline correctly builds and deploys the application.
